question: Related Questions Q. To go 3/1 Chilla in Tablig Jamat is mendotory for me? 6836 views Q. A Haqb is equal to eighty years of three hundred and sixty days each, and a day in the Hereafter shall equal one thousand years of this world." The reference given is of a book MAJALIS-E-ABRAAR NOW my question is whether this Hadith is Sahih or not. If it is Sahih then please give the reference of its original source. If its otherwise then, Is there any other Sahih Hadith that tells about the punishment for the one who misses the Salah and then even offers it as Qadha. Of there is no sahih Hadith regarding the subject then is it right to narrate it. Hope I made my point clear. ALLAH will surely reward you for the help. Please make dua for magfirah and for my family from breaking apart. wil my sins be forgiven. Question: i am married and converted to islam 17years ago. I had 4 kids when I migrated from my country. I was involved in zina with someone for about 8 years and i have a child with him. I have confessed to my husband and I also did haj, but after haj we commitedd zina. I was wondering wll allah swt forgive me. I have done taubah and Know i have no contact with him and I even dont go out of my house but what I did is really hurting mre and my family and i really regret being doing it. Please make dua for magfirah and for my family from breaking apart. wil my sins be forgiven. jazakallah. Answer ID: 29432 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 265/D=16/k=1432) Adultery is stern offence and an act that invites Almighty Allah's wrath. It is good that by the grace of Allah, you have asked Allah for forgiveness and now you feel regretful and have firmly resolved that in future you will never commit such acts. You should offer two rakah salah and seek Allah's forgiveness extensively. It is hoped that Almighty Allah shall forgive you. After true tauba, Almighty Allah forgives the past sins and man becomes pure. It is mentioned in a hadith: التائب من الذنب كمن لا ذنب له . [A person who does tauba from sins is as if he has committed no sins.] We pray for you and for your family. May Almighty Allah give you taufiq for good deeds and save you from sins and bless you with His pleasure and give you entry into paradise and save you from hellfire, Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
